_bob.purpose: A 1K tile to 2K or 4K, tiled, without reintroducing the seam W1 removed.
_bob.derived_from: tex_tileable.json (W1) for the circular halves, plus the stock UltimateSDUpscale single-node recipe from ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale's README
deviations_from_source: The model and the VAE both arrive circular-padded (SeamlessTile + MakeCircularVAE), because UltimateSDUpscale re-samples and re-decodes every tile: with a stock VAE the wrap seam comes straight back, which is the same failure the W1 measurements found.

seam_fix_mode is None. Its seam fixer is for the seams BETWEEN internal tiles, which Linear mode plus mask_blur already handles here, and running it re-denoises bands of the image for no measured gain.
force_uniform_tiles is true, so the tile grid divides the image evenly and no undersized edge tile gets a different effective denoise.
The upscale model is templated as BOB_UPSCALE_MODEL rather than hardcoded (R6).
_bob.notes: BOB_SEED titles the UltimateSDUpscale node, which carries seed, denoise and upscale_by as fields (see tex_tileable_ref.json's denoise_is_a_field note). Denoise 0.2 by default: the 4x ESRGAN pass does the resolution and the diffusion pass only adds grain, so a higher denoise starts inventing a different texture than the one that was accepted.
